tools.title: Google News Scraper
tools.summary: Search Google News by keyword, topic or publisher and get articles with title, source, date, snippet and the resolved publisher URL. Any language or country.
tools.description: Supports Google News operators such as "exact phrase", site:reuters.com, when:7d and before:2026-01-01. Up to 100 articles per query. Google's encoded redirect links are resolved to the publisher's real URL.

tools.title: App Store Reviews Scraper
tools.summary: Apple App Store reviews for any iOS app and country storefront: rating, title, text, version, author, date, plus app metadata.

sample_output.title: Confusing
sample_output.content: It's probably because I'm new but it is really confusing to work with.

tools.description: Apple exposes the 500 most recent reviews per app per country (sorted by most recent or most helpful). Run on a schedule and deduplicate by reviewId to build a history.

tools.title: Shopify Products Scraper
tools.summary: Full product catalog of any Shopify store or collection: prices, compare-at prices, variants, SKUs, stock, images, tags and descriptions.
tools.description: Works on any Shopify storefront without login. Pass a store homepage for the whole catalog, a /collections/<handle> URL for one collection, or a /products/<handle> URL for a single product.
